note: Perf budget baseline — a ratchet. Never raise to silence the gate; lower when a real win lands. See scripts/perf-budget.mjs. The two HTML rows were raised on 2026-09-06 for one reason: the stylesheet is now inlined into every prerendered document (scripts/inline-css.mjs, DECISIONS.md) so first paint no longer waits on three render-blocking fetches; each document carries ~96 KB of CSS it did not before. homeCss and sharedJs were not touched. On 2026-10-01 layoutJs was added — the chunks the root layout loads, which every public page pays and the shared row never counted — and set at the figure after the roster and the Google Analytics loader left that chunk (387,387 B before). homeCss and maxHtml were lowered to the build of the same day; sharedJs and medianHtml were left where they were. Later on 2026-10-01 medianHtml was raised from 177,607 to 186,792 B for one named change: the city-service pages (65 of the 307 documents, and the median document is one of them) now carry who you would see, the catalogue fee and their own FAQs — 7.7 KB of visible content in <main> plus Next's RSC copy of it, measured against a build of 707d6e7. Every other section's median moved under 4.5 KB. The same day layoutJs fell back from 401,619 to 351,146 B when the conversion-detail allow-list stopped shipping the roster to the browser (lib/conversion-detail-client.ts).
